title: Induction on covering sieves generated by a coverage
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. A presieve on $X$ is a set of arrows with target $X$, and $\langle R\rangle$ denotes the sieve of arrows factoring through some member of a presieve $R$. Let $P(X)$ be a collection of presieves for each $X$. Assume the coverage condition: for every $R\in P(X)$ and $f:Y\to X$ there is $R'\in P(Y)$ such that each $g:Z\to Y$ in $R'$ has a factorization $f\circ g=r\circ a$, with $r:W\to X$ in $R$ and $a:Z\to W$. Let $J_P$ be the smallest Grothendieck topology containing all $\langle R\rangle$ with $R\in P(X)$ [def-weil-pbc-topos]. For any family of propositions $Q(X,S)$ indexed by objects and sieves on them, assume (i) $Q(X,\langle R\rangle)$ for all $R\in P(X)$; (ii) $Q(X,\top_X)$ for all $X$; and (iii) for sieves $A,B$ on $X$, $Q(X,A)$ and $Q(Y,f^*B)$ for every $f:Y\to X$ in $A$ imply $Q(X,B)$. Then $Q(X,S)$ holds for every $S\in J_P(X)$. No closure of $P$ under composition, isomorphic replacements, or indexed presentations, and no existence of categorical pullbacks, is assumed.
